# Setup

Set `OPENAI_API_KEY=sk-...xxxx` in your shell, or pass `Authorization: Bearer <TOKEN>`.

```bash
export OPENAI_API_KEY=sk-proj-1234xxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxx
export GITHUB_TOKEN=<your-token>
```
